extDesc.message: Blocks pop-ups, overlays, video ads and click hijacking via behavior detection, self-learning rules and EasyList lists.
extDesc.description: Store listing and extension-management summary. Must stay within 132 characters.

appTitle.description: Product title shown in the popup/options UI (page title and brand row). Keep the product name as-is; translate only the part after the hyphen.

popupInternalNotice.message: Browser-internal and extension pages cannot be filtered. Use AdBlow on a regular web page.

popupToggleAria.message: Enable or disable filtering on this site

popupHintDisabled.message: Disabled here — filtering and learning are stopped.

popupHintLearning.message: A learned rule activates after 3 hits (currently $1 active).

popupHintNoStats.message: No statistics for this page yet. Reload to see them.

popupConfirmClear.message: Clear all rules AdBlow learned on $1?

popupWallTitle.description: Anti-adblock wall card heading; shown only when a wall was detected on this site.

popupWallDetected.message: This site is covering the page with an anti-adblock prompt. The fix hides only that prompt layer and restores the content it covered — ad blocking stays unchanged.
popupWallDetected.description: Wall card body before the user confirms; states exactly what the fix changes.

popupWallOn.message: Fix on: hides only that prompt layer and restores the covered content; ad blocking stays unchanged.
popupWallOn.description: Wall card body once the fix is enabled for this site.

popupWallEnable.description: Wall card button that enables the fix for this site.

popupWallDisable.description: Wall card button that turns the fix off for this site.

optionsLede.message: Hiding rules AdBlow learned on its own, site by site. You can revoke any of them individually.

optionsWarn.message: Once a learned rule is promoted it applies unconditionally on later visits, so it takes 3 hits to promote. If a site breaks, disable filtering for that site in the popup first, then come back and delete the suspicious rule.

optionsEmpty.message: No rules learned yet. AdBlow accumulates them automatically while you browse.

optionsSummary.message: $1 selector(s) active / $2 total · $3 domain(s) blocked / $4 total

optionsListData.message: Built-in filter lists: fetched $1 · $2 lists · $3 network rules

optionsPickSite.message: Select every rule of this site

optionsConfirmDeleteSelected.message: Delete the $1 selected rule(s)? This cannot be undone.

optionsDomainHint.message: A domain is blocked automatically after appearing in ads 3 times. Domains also used by normal content are never learned.
